tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /sngags 'chang ngag gi dbang po kun dga' rin chen gyi kun rig gi chog khrigs chen mo gsung rtsom gnang 'phro las logs su bkod pa'i dbang chog bzhugs// na mo gu ru a nan+da rat+na ya/ 'dir ngan song thams cad yongs su sbyong ba kun rig rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor du slob ma dbang bskur bya ba ni/ slob ma 'os su gyur pa gcig nas nyi shu rtsa lnga'i bar zung du ma gyur pa khrus kyi don du chab btang ste gral la 'khod pa la/ las kyi slob mas me tog bkye bsdu tshar ba dang / slob dpon gyis/ 'o nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad kyi don du khyab bdag rnam snang chen po'i go 'phang thob par bya/ de'i ched du ngan song thams cad yongs su sbyong ba kun rig rnam par snang mdzad kyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba zab mo gsan snyam pa byang chub kyi mchog tu thugs bskyed pa dang / chos gsan pa'i kun tu spyod pa rnams kyang rdo rje theg pa'i gzhung lugs dri ma med pa nas ji ltar 'byung ba bzhin gsal btab ste gsan par zhu/ de la 'dir yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams kyis gdul bya so so'i bsam pa dang / khams dang / bag la nyal dang rjes su mthun par chos kyi rnam grangs bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig gsungs kyang / de rnams kyi nang nas mchog tu gyur pa rdo rje theg pa yin zhing / de la rgyud sde gsum dang / bzhi dang lnga dang / drug tu 'dod pa la sogs mang du yod pa las/ rgyud sde gsum pa rnal 'byor gyi rgyud yin/ de la yang rtsa rgyud/ bshad rgyud/ cha mthun gyi rgyud sde rnam pa gsum las/ da lan 'dir skabs su bab pa cha mthun kyi rgyud kyi khongs su gtogs pa ngan song thams cad yongs su sbyongs ba'i rgyud kyi rgyal po chen po/ grub chen kun snying gis bkral ba'i rjes su 'brangs nas/ rgyud de'i brtag pa dang po'i dngos bstan/ bstan bya'i gtso bor gyur pa kun rig rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor du mngon par dbang bskur ba sgrub par byed pa la/

gang gi dbang bskur slob dpon ni/ /sngags dang rgyud dang man ngag shes/ /cho ga'i las la rab tu mkhas/ /snying rjes slob ma rab 'dzin pa/ /dbang bskur ba yi slob dpon mchog /ces gsungs pa ltar gyi mtshan nyid ci rigs dang ldan pa zhig dgos shing / gang la dbang bskur ba'i slob ma yang / dad dang snying rjes sems rab dul/ /rnam rtog nyung zhing blo dang ldan/ /sngags kyi lam mchog don gnyer ba/ /mthun zhing grangs dang ldan par bzung / /zhes pa ltar gyi mtshan nyid ci rigs dang ldan pa nyi shu rtsa lnga man chad nges par dgos pa yin/ ji ltar bskur ba'i cho ga la slob dpon gyi bya ba dang / slob ma'i bya ba gnyis kyi/ dang po slob dpon gyi bya ba ni/ mchod pa byin rlabs sngon du 'gro bas bdag bskyed bzlas pa dang bcas pa/ bum pa bsgrub pa/ mdun bskyed bsgrub cing mchod pa/ 'jig rten pa la gtor ma btang ba/ bdag nyid 'jug cing dbang blang ba/ bdag bsgrub cing bzlas pa bya ba rnams sngon du legs par song nas/ da khyed rang rnams kyi ngo skal du gyur pa/ gnyis pa slob ma'i bya ba la/ slob ma sta gon 'jug pa dang bcas pa dang / dngos gzhi dbang bskur ba gnyis las/ dang po slob ma sta gon gyi chos rnams zhu ba'i yon du maṇ+ḍal zhig 'bul ba zhu/ de ltar maṇ+ḍal phul nas me tog dang bcas pas thal mo sbyar te gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum gyi bar du mdzod/ dga' chen khyod bdag ston pa ste/ /sogs lan gsum/ sta gon 'jug pa dang bcas pa rnams la chos bcu bdun yod pa las/ thog mar rgyun bshags sngon du 'gro ba can gyi sems bskyed pa'i don du dmigs pa 'di bzhin du mdzod/ mdun gyi nam mkhar bla ma dang gnyis su med pa'i kun rig rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha sum cu rtsa bdun mgron thabs kyi lha dang bcas pa la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba'i spyan sngar khyed rang rnams 'khod nas sdig pa bshags pa la sogs pa'i yan lag bdun pa bgyid snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/

dbang med bdag gis mi dge bgyis pa dang / /sogs lan gsum/ de ltar rgyud dag par byas nas/ nang gi sems bskyed pa'i don du slob dpon gyis/ sa ma ya āḥ zhes brjod pas khyed rang rnams kyi snying kar kun rdzob byang chub sems kyi ngo bo zla ba'i dkyil 'khor nya gang ba lta bu'i steng du/ don dam byang chub sems kyi rang bzhin rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga pa 'od zer rab tu 'phro ba dang bcas pa re gsal lam ste byung ba'i mos pa mdzod/ de nyid slob dpon gyi snying khar rdo rje bzhag pa'i sgo nas brtan par byas pa'i mos pa mdzod/ ces brjod cing slob ma'i snying khar rdo rje bzhag la/ oṃ su ra te sogs brjod/ de nas dam tshig dang sdom pa 'dzin pa la rigs lnga spyi dang so so'i dam tshig gnyis su 'dus pa las/ spyi'i dam tshig ni gzhan don rdzogs pa'i byang chub thob par bya'o snyam pa'i smon pa dang / de'i ched du nyes spyod thams cad sdom pa dang / dge ba chos bsdud dang / sems can don byed rnams bsgrub par bya snyam pa 'jug pa sems bskyed pa rnams yin zhing / so so'i dam tshig ni rnam snang gi dam tshig tu/ dkon mchog gsum mi 'bral bar 'dzin pa dang / mi bskyod pa'i dam tshig tu rdo rje dril bu phyag rgya'i de kho na nyid dang / bla ma dang bzhi 'dzin pa/ rin chen 'byung ldan gyi dam tshig tu chos kyi sbyin pa/ zang zing gi sbyin pa/ mi 'jigs pa skyabs kyi sbyin pa/ byams pa'i sbyin pa ste nyin lan gsum/ mtshan lan gsum du gtong ba/ 'od dpag med kyi dam tshig tu phyi bya spyod/ gsang ba rnal 'byor rgyud/ nyan thos/ rang rgyal/ byang chub sems dpa'i theg pa rnams 'dzin pa/ don yod grub pa'i dam tshig tu gong gi dam tshig sdom pa rnams la nan tan gyi sgo nas/ bla ma dkon mchog la mchod pa'i las ci nus su bya ba rnams yin/ de ltar shes par byas nas rigs lnga spyi dang bye brag gis bsdus pa'i dam tshig dang sdom pa rnams 'dzin snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/

ji ltar dus gsum mgon po rnams/ /sogs lan gsum/ de ltar sems bskyed nas/ sngags dang phyag rgyas byin gyis rlabs pa'i don du slob dpon gyis rigs gsum spyi'i sngags rgyas khyed rang rnams kyi gnas gsum du gtugs pa la brten nas/ lus ngag yid gsum de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs kyi ngo bor byin gyis brlabs pa'i mos pa mdzod/ ces brjod cing slob dpon gyi thal mo slob ma'i dpral bar reg la/ oṃ bh+ri ta sogs dang / thal mo snying khar sbyar ba mgrin par bzhag la/ oṃ traṭa traṭa sogs dang / rdo rje bsdams pa las gung mo gnyis dang mthe bong che chung rnams brkyangs te rtse sbyar ba snying khar bzhag oṃ tshin+dha tshin+dha sogs brjod/ de ltar sgo gsum gyi byin gyis brlabs nas/ snying kha lkog ma kha phyogs dang / /dpral ba mdzod spu rna ba gnyis/ /mgo bo gtsug phud dpung ba gnyis/ /sna dang sked pa pus mo bol/ /long bu sna yi rtse mo dang / /mig gnyis dang ni gsang ba'i gnas/ /zhes pa ltar gyi dpral ba mdzod spu gcig tu byas pa'i gnas nyi shu rtsa gnyis su slob dpon gyi khu tshur steng 'og tu re mos kyis kha sbyar te gnas de dag tu reg cing / oṃ badz+ra a dhi tiṣ+ṭha dzñā na sa ma ye hūm̐ zhes brjod pa la brten nas/ snying kha la sogs pa'i gnas de dang de dag rdo rje'i rang bzhin du byin gyis brlabs pa'i mos pa mdzod/ de nas khyed rang rnams rdo rje sems dpar gyur pa'i mos pa mdzad nas nga rgyal 'dzin pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ oṃ badz+ra satwa ham̐/ zhes brjod pa la brten nas rang nyid rdo rje sems dpa'i nga rgyal 'dzin pa ste de rnams ni byin gyis brlabs pa yin/ smon lam gdab pa ni/ rang gi 'das ma 'ongs da lta dus gsum du bsags pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba rnams kyi mthu dang nus pa la brten nas sems can thams cad sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par gyur cig snyam pas thal mo sbyar te 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/

bdag gi dge ba'i rtsa ba 'dis sogs brjod/ de ltar brjod nas zab mo'i chos bshad pa'i sgo nas spro ba bskyed pa 'di la gsan pas khyab par gda'/ 'jig rten du ni kun mkhyen dag /sogs brjod/ de'i don 'di yin te 'jig rten na gang dkon na u dum wa ra'i me tog dkon/ dkon pa ltar sangs rgyas 'jig rten du 'byon pa dkon/ de las kyang chos gsung ba dkon/ chos kyi nang nas kyang gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa gsung ba dkon/ de ltar dkon pa ltar phan yon chen po dang ldan pa yin te/ dkyil 'khor chen po mthong ba tsam gyi mod la/ bskal pa bye ba dpag tu med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib thams cad 'dag par 'gyur na/ dbang blangs te dam tshig dang sdom pa la nan tan du byas nas lam sgom pa la brtson pa bskyed na 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal las thar pa lta ci smos/ de bas na khyed rang rnams kyis rnyed pa'i mchog legs par rnyed cing / rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa rnams kyi mkhyen brtse nus gsum gyis yongs su bzung ste/ de rigs su skye bzhin par gyur pas theg pa chen po'i lam mchog 'di la brten nas sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang myur du thob par 'gyur bas blo 'di las gzhan du ma 'gyur bar dga' ba dang spro ba rgya chen po sgom par mdzod cig de ltar spro ba bskyed nas bsrung ba bya ba'i slad du slob dpon gyis/ 'jig rten gsum rgyal gyi sngags rgya khyed rang rnams kyi gnas gsum du gtugs shing / oṃ badz+ra satwa kro dha sogs lan gsum brjod/ de ltar gnas gsum du gtugs pa la brten nas/ khyed rang rnams kyi lus ngag yid gsum dang / dbang len pa la bar du gcod pa thams cad nye bar zhi bar byin gyis brlabs pa'i mos pa mdzod/ de ltar bar chad bsrung ba rnams kyis slob ma sta gon gyi cho ga song nas/ 'jug pa'i chos rnams zhu ba'i yon du maṇ+ḍal zhig 'bul ba zhu/ de ltar maṇ+ḍal phul nas/

khyed rang rnams sngon chad bcom ldan 'das kun rig rnam par snang mdzad kyi dkyil 'khor du ma zhugs pa'am/ zhugs kyang bskyar nas 'jug pa'i mtshon byed du dar yug dmar po res gdongs bcings pa'i mos pa mdzod/ ā kham̐ wi ra hūm̐ zhes pas gdong bcings nas dkyil 'khor gyi lha dang mjal ba de'i tshe phyag stong par mjal du mi rung bas na/ u dum wa ra la sogs pa'i me tog phreng ba re phyag brten gyis slad du byin pa'i mos pa mdzod/ ā kham̐ wi ra hūm̐/ de ltar byin te 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ oṃ badz+ra a dhi tiṣ+ṭha hūm̐/ zhes brjod pas khyed rang rnams rdo rje sems dpar lam ste gyur par mos nas/ khyed rnams kyi lag pa rdo rje bsdams pa las gung mo gnyis mnyam du brkyangs pa rdo rje 'dzin ma'i phyag rgyas rdo rje me tog bzung nas dkyil 'khor gyi phyogs la dbu dud pa tsam dang bcas pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ oṃ badz+ra sa ma ya hūm̐/ zhes brjod pas dkyil 'khor gyi shar sgo'i nang du 'khod pa'i mos pa mdzod/ de nas ye shes dbab pa'i don du dmigs pa 'di bzhin du mdzod/ dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs la gus 'dud drag po zhig byas pas/ gtso bo la sogs pa lha rnams kyi thugs ka nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs ye shes lnga'i rang bzhin hūm̐ gi rnam pa tshad med grangs med bsam gyis mi khyab pa byon nas/ khyed rang rnams kyi lus la char chen po babs pa bzhin sib sib thim pa la brten nas khyed rang rnams kyi snying khar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs gnyis su med pa'i ye shes yi ge hūm̐ gi rnam pas zhugs pa la brten nas rgyud byin gyis brlabs pa'i mos pa mdzod/ slob dpon gyi rdo rje bsdams pa'i phyag rgya khyed rang rnams kyi snying khar reg ste/ oṃ badz+ra pra be sha ya hūm̐/ zhes mang du brjod/ ye shes phab pa'i nyams myong rgyud la skyes pa de spyi bor rdo rje rgya gram du bzhag pa'i sgo nas brtan par byas shing nyams myong skyes pa de su la yang ma smra zhig

ces dam la bzhag pa'i mos pa mdzod/ oṃ a sa me tri sa me ma hā sa ma ye hūm̐/ zhes brjod de brtan par bya ba dang dam la bzhag par bya ba yin/ zhes thams cad kyi spyi bor rdo rje rgya gram du bzhag de nas khyed rang rnams gral rim bzhin bzhengs te/ 'di na bcom ldan 'das ngan song thams cad yongs su sbyong ba gzi brjid kyi rgyal po kun rig rnam par snang mdzad 'khor dang bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor bzhugs pa yin te/ de'ang gdul bya 'dul ba'i phyir du gtso bo dang 'khor gyi rnam pa can du bstan pa tsam ma gtogs sangs rgyas kyi ye shes gcig nyid las grub pa yin pas bzang ngan nam/ mchog dman gyi rnam pa cung zad tsam yang med mod/ 'on kyang rang gi las 'brel bsags pa'i lha zhig la 'bab par shog snyam pa'i sgo nas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ sangs rgyas dngos grub thob bya'i phyir/ /bdag la thugs brtser dgongs nas ni/ /'gro la phan phyir gtso chen gyis/ /dman par dgongs te bzhes su gsol/ /oṃ badz+ra pra ti grih+ṇa hūm̐ zhes gtso bo la 'bul ba'i stangs ka re mdzod/ slob dpon gyis me tog gi phreng ba de nyid sngags kyi phreng bar byin gyis brlabs nas/ khyed rang rnams kyi spyi bor bzhag ste byin gyis brlabs pa'i mos pa mdzod/ oṃ pra tits+tsha badz+ra sa ma ya satwam̐/ de nas slob dpon gyis oṃ badz+ra ha s+ya u gha ṭa ya hūm̐/ zhes gdong ras bkrol te/ de ltar mi shes pa'i mig gi rab rib dag nas ye shes kyi mig thob ste thar pa chen po'i dkyil 'khor mngon sum du gzigs pa'i mos pa mdzod/ oṃ badz+ra pā sh+ya hoḥzhes pas dkyil 'khor blta bar bskul te gang la blta ba'i dkyil 'khor ni/ kun rig rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs yin te/ de yang slob dpon gyis ngag tu brjod pa bzhin/ khyed rang rnams sems ma yengs par gsan te gsal lam ste gzigs pa'i mos pa mdzod/ de la 'byung ba rim brtsegs ri rab dang bcas pa'i steng du rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i gzhal yas khang gru bzhi pa/

sgo bzhi pa/ phyi nas rim pa bzhin sngo/ ser/ dmar/ ljang / dkar ba'i rtsig pa rim pa lnga dang ldan pa'i steng rin po che'i pha gus bskor ba'i steng nas dra ba dang dra ba phyed pa 'phyang zhing / mda' yab dang spu shus mdzes par byas pa/ sgo bzhi'i steng gi thad sor ka ba bzhis btegs pa'i rta babs bang rim bzhi dang ldan pa'i rtse mor chos kyi 'khor lo dang / gdugs dang / g.yas g.yon du ri dwags pho mo dang / snam bu so so la rgyal mtshan dang / 'phan la sogs pa'i rgyan du mas brgyan pa/ rtsig pa'i phyi rol 'dod snam gyi snam bu dmar po la mchod pa'i lha mo sna tshogs pa mchod rdzas du ma thogs nas 'khod nas/ de'i phyi rol 'khyams kha dog sna tshogs pa'i phyi rol tu 'jig rten pa'i khor yug sngon po/ phyi rol rdo rje'i rwa ba dang 'od zer 'phreng bas yongs su bskor ba'o/ /de'i nang du rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor gru bzhi/ sgo bzhi/ rta babs bzhi dang bcas pa mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i nang du chos kyi 'khor lo sngon po rtsibs bcu drug pa/ lte ba le tshe dgu pa'i phyogs bzhi nas ka ba gnyis gnyis te brgyad kyis btegs pa'i steng rdo rje'i gdung zlum po dang / de'i steng rdo rje gdung bzhis mig mangs ris su bres shing mdzes par phub pa/ dbus phyur bur gyur pa'i steng du rdo rje dang rin po che'i tog gis brgyan pa/ khang bzang gnyis ka'i nang gi gzhi thams cad shar sngo/ lho ser/ nub dmar/ byang ljang / dbus kyi re mig dkar po'i dbus su seng ge'i khri/ shar du glang po che'i khri/ lhor rta'i khri/ nub tu rma bya'i khri/ byang du mkha' lding rnams kyis btegs pa'i rin po che'i khri'i steng dang / lha thams cad kyi gnas su pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan dang / phyi sgo khro bo rnams la nyi ma'i gdan/ 'jig rten pa'i khor yug la srog chags la sogs pa so so'i gdan rnams yongs su rdzogs par gyur pa ni/

rten gzhal yas khang pa yin la/ brten pa lha ni dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du bcom ldan 'das kun rig rnam par snang mdzad/ shar du sbyong ba'i rgyal po/ lhor rgyal mchog rin chen/ nub tu shākya ri dbang / byang du me tog cher rgyas te rigs lnga/ shar lhor spyan ma/ lho nub tu mā ma ki nub byang du gos dkar mo/ byang shar du sgrol ma ste yum bzhi dang / 'khor lo'i shar rtsibs la sogs pa rtsibs bcu drug tu rdo rje sems dpa' la sogs pa'i sems dpa' bcu drug nang gi grwa bzhir sgeg mo la sogs pa'i nang gi lha mo bzhi/ phyi'i grwa bzhir bdug spos ma la sogs phyi'i lha mo bzhi/ nang gi sgo bzhir lcags kyu ma la sogs pa'i nang gi sgo ma bzhi ste rtsa ba'i lha sum cu rtsa bdun dang / gzhal yas khang phyi ma'i lha snam dang po la phyogs bzhir byams pa la sogs pa byang chub sems dpa' bzhi bzhi ste bcu drug de'i phyi rol gyi lha snam gyi phyogs bzhir 'phags pa dga' bo la sogs pa'i nyan thos bcu drug snam bu de nyid kyi mtshams bzhi dang / phyogs bzhi'i g.yas g.yon gnyis te gnas bcu gnyis su gdung ba sel ba la sogs pa'i rang rgyal bcu gnyis/ sgo phyi ma bzhi'i dbus dang g.yas g.yon gnyis rgyab rnams su khro bo bzhi/ pho nya bzhi/ mngags pa bzhi/ bran bzhi ste sgo ba bcu drug dang / phyi'i khor yug gi gdan rnams la tshangs pa la sogs pa'i phyogs skyong bcu/ lha chen brgyad/ klu chen brgyad/ gza' chen brgyad/ rgyu skar nyi shu rtsa brgyad/ rgyal chen bzhi/ 'jigs byed dgu gtsang rigs kyi mgon po bdun cu rtsa lnga/ gnod sbyin/ srin po/ bud med/ phra men ma/ rdo rje gnod sbyin ma'i tshogs rnams dang / gzhan yang ri'i lha/ shing gi lha/ grong gi lha/ 'byung bzhi'i lha la sogs pa 'jig rten pa rnams kyang rang gi rgyan cha lugs dang ldan zhing so so'i g.yog 'khor bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang ldan pa ste/

mdor na bcom ldan 'das kun rig rnam par snang mdzad 'khor dang bcas pa'i rten dang brten pa'i dkyil 'khor thams cad mngon sum lta bur mthong ba yin snyam du dga' spro dang ldan pa'i sgo nas dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo rang gi me tog 'phog pa'i lha yin snyam pa'i mos pa mdzod/ de nas dam tshig 'dzin pa'i don du 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ oṃ badz+ra sa ma ya hūm̐ phaṭ/ zhes brjod pas lha thams cad kyi dam tshig lus la zhugs pa'i mos pa mdzod/ de nyid brtan pa'i don du slob dpon gyi rdo rje'i phyag rgya khyed rang rnams kyi snying khar gtugs pas kun rig snying la zhugs pa'i mos pa mdzod/ ces brjod cing phyag rgya reg yang slob dpon gyis rdo rje 'dzin ma'i phyag rgyas slob ma'i snying khar gtugs te/ oṃ badz+ra sa ma ya hri da ya me pra be sha ya dri ḍo tiṣ+ṭha hūm̐ phaṭ/ de nas bum chu sbyin te/ dam tshig bsgrags pa'i don du mna' chu blud pa'i mos pa mdzod/ 'di ni khyod kyi dmyal ba'i chu/ /zhes pa nas/ bdag gi de nyid dang ni sngags sogs de bzhin no/ /zhes pa'i bar brjod cing bum chu blud tshar ba dang / de'i don ni 'di yin te/ 'di ni khyod kyi dmyal ba'i chu/ /zhes pa nas/ shin tu mos pas bsrung bar bya/ zhes dam tshig bsgrags te/ khyod kyis srog chags gsod mi bya/ /zhes pa nas/ bdag gi de nyid dang ni sngags sogs de bzhin no/ /zhes pa'i bar gyis sdom pa byin pa yin te/ de'i don srog gcod pa/ ma byin par len pa/ brdzun du smra ba/ 'dod pas log par g.yem pa ste rtsa ba bzhi/ chang dang lnga ni dbang thob cing phyin chad khyim pas kyang bsrung dgos na/ rab tu byung bas lta ci smos te/ de rnams dam tshig gtso bo lta bu yin pas srog dang bsdos nas bsrung dgos so/ /de'i steng du bsad sha za ba la sogs pa sems can la gnod par 'gyur ba la sogs pa'i bsam pa thams cad spangs nas/

dkon mchog rnam pa gsum dang / dus rtag tu byang chub kyi sems dang / sngags dang / phyag rgya dang / lha dang bla ma rnams nam yang spang bar mi bya zhing / mi dge ba bcu la sogs pa sdig pa'i las thams cad bla ma'i bka' bzhin las mi 'da' ba dang / lha la phul ba'i mchod pa'i ro ma/ snyigs ma dang / sku gzugs kyi grib ma dang / phyag mtshan gyi gzugs brnyan rnams la'ang 'gom par mi bya zhing / sngags dang lha la mi smad pa dang / gzhan la phan pa'i byang chub kyi sems dang mi ldan par gdon bgegs bskrad pa dang / gzir ba la sogs pa'i las mi byed/ grub mtha' blo bsgyur ba yin pas mu stegs la'ang mi smad/ mdor na sangs rgyas kyis gsungs pa'i dam tshig la sogs pa'i chos thams cad la yid gnyis dang the tshom mi bya bar shin tu dad cing gus pa'i sgo nas bsrung sdom tshul bzhin du bya dgos so/ /de rnams kyis dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa'i chos song nas/ dngos gzhi dbang bskur ba zhu ba'i yon du maṇ+ḍal zhig 'bul ba zhu/ zhes maṇ+ḍal bdun ma phul la/ ma tshang ba med pa 'di nyid ni rdo rje slob ma'i dbang bskur zhu ba'i yon du sogs gong bzhin dang / de ltar maṇ+ḍal phul nas gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ byang chub rdo rje sogs lan gsum/ de ltar gsol ba btab nas thog mar sngags kyi dbang bskur ba'i don du dmigs pa 'di bzhin du mdzod/ mdun bskyed kyi rten dang brten par bcas pa las sangs rgyas thams cad kyi byin rlabs sngags kyi rnam pa'i yig 'bru gser btso ma lta bu'i mdog can dpag tu med pa byung ste khyed rang rnams rdo rje sems dpar gsal ba'i spyi bo nas zhugs pas tshe thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib las ngan thams cad byang zhing dag par byin gyis brlabs pa yin snyam du mos pa mdzod/ de nyid brtan pa'i phyir du slob dpon gyis spyi bor rdo rje bzhag ste/ oṃ na mo sogs rtsa rig dang /

oṃ sarba bid ces pa nas/ oṃ bha zhes pa'i bar brjod pas sngags kyi byin rlabs rgyud la zhugs pa'i mos pa mdzod/ de nas bum pa'i dbang bskur ba'i don du dmigs pa 'di bzhin du mdzod/ mdun bskyed kyi lha rnams kyi thugs ka nas dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs bsam gyis mi khyab pa mdun gyi nam mkhar sprul te/ de rnams slob dpon lhan cig pas 'og nas 'byung ba'i dbang rnams rim pa bzhin bskur ba'i mos pa bya dgos pa las/ thog mar rigs lnga'i rang bzhin can gyi bum pa bdud rtsis gang ba thogs nas khyed rang rnams rdo rje sems dpar gsal ba'i spyi bo la sogs pa'i gnas lngar bzhag ste dbang bskur ba'i mos pa mdzod/ oṃ bud+dha ka la sha sogs lnga brjod/ bum chu sbyin zhes gsungs shing bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur bas lus thams cad gang / dri ma thams cad dag pa'i mos pa mdzod/ de nas rigs lnga'i rang bzhin can gyi dbu rgyan spyi bor bcings te/ oṃ bud+dha a dhi sogs lnga brjod cing byin la/ de nyid brtan pa'i don du phyag rgya lngas dbang bskur ba'i mos pa mdzod/ oṃ bud+dha sogs gong bzhin bskyar nas brjod pa dang bstun slob ma'i spyi bo la sogs pa'i gnas lngar rigs lnga'i phyag rgya bca' ba thams cad la tshar ba dang / phyag rgya lngas kyang dbang bskur bas rigs lnga'i sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub thob par byas pa yin snyam du mos pa mdzod/ de ltar phyag rgyas dbang bskur nas/ cod pan gyi dbang la yang gnyis yod pa'i dang po rin po che'i phreng ba dbu rgyan gyi rtsa chings su byin pa'i mos pa mdzod/ oṃ rat+na ma la a bhi ṣiñtsa tram̐ tram̐ tram̐ tram̐ tram̐/ zhes gsungs shing dbang bskur bas gzhan don byed pa'i nus pa dang / dbang bskur bas gzhan don byed pa la mthu dang ldan par byas pa'i mos pa mdzod/ de gsum ni cod pan gyi dbang ngo / /de nas phyag rgya lnga'i dbang gi don du/

tsa ka li la rigs lnga'i phyag mtshan dang phyag mtshan lngas yu ba byas pa'i dril bu lag tu byin te/ oṃ bud+dha mu dra sogs lnga brjod cing lag pa g.yas g.yon du sbyin tshar ba dang / zhes gsung zhing dbang bskur bas rigs lnga dang ye shes lnga'i dbang thob pa'i mos pa mdzod/ de ni rdo rje dril bu'i dbang ngo / /ming gi dbang gi don du dmigs pa 'di bzhin du mdzod/ slob dpon dang nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i lha rnams kyis rigs lnga'i ming btags pa'i mos pa mdzod/ ces brjod cing / slob dpon gyis rdo rje dril bu lhan cig tu slob ma'i spyi bo la sogs pa'i gnas lngar dkrol zhing / oṃ bud+dha na ma sogs lnga brjod de rdo rje sems dpa' zhes pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa'o/ /zhes gsung zhing ming gi dbang bskur bas ma 'ongs pa na sangs rgyas kyi mtshan nges pa can thob par byas pa yin no/ /de dag ni ye shes lnga'i rang bzhin rigs lnga'i dbang ngo / /de dag brtan pa'i phyir dang / 'phrin las kyi dbang gi don du rdo rje dril bu mnyam du slob ma'i lag par reg tsam byin te/ oṃ badz+ra karma a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐ āḥ zhes gsung zhing dbang bskur bas 'phrin las bzhi'i sgo nas gzhan don 'bad med du byed nus pa yin no/ /de ni rdo rje'i brtul zhugs so/ /de rnams kyis rdo rje slob ma'i dbang song nas/ rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang gi don du 'khor lo re phyag tu gtad cing dbang bskur ba'i mos pa mdzod/ ces dang / 'khor lo bris pa'i tsa ka li lag tu gtad cing slob ma'i snying kar gtugs pa re byas pa'i mos pa mdzod/ oṃ badz+ra tsakra a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐ bh+rum̐/ zhes gsungs shing dbang bskur ba'i rkyen gyis khyed rang rnams seng ges btegs pa'i khri sna tshogs pad+ma zla ba'i gdan gyi steng du rnam snang chen po'i rang bzhin rdo rje sems dpa' sku mdog dkar po rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa/

dar dang rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa re rer gsal lam ste gyur pa'i mos pa mdzod/ de nas bdag po'i dbang ngam/ sku dam tshig gi don du rdo dril lag pa g.yas kyis lhan cig tu slob ma'i spyi bo la sogs pa'i gnas lngar dkrol te/ oṃ bud+dha tsakra sogs lnga brjod/ zhes gsung zhing dbang bskur bas khyed rang rnams rigs thams cad kyi bdag por dbang thob pa'i mos pa mdzod/ de nas gar bskor dang bcas pa'i phyag chen lnga dpon slob gnyis kas mdzad pa zhu/ zhes phyag rgya dang bcas la/ oṃ bud+dha tsakra sogs gong bzhin lnga brjod/ zhes dbang bskur bas khyed rang rnams rigs lnga spro ba po rnam snang rdor sems su gyur pa'i mos pa mdzad de/ phyag rgya sku'i dam tshig go /de nas rdo rje/ chos 'byung / pad+ma/ spyan/ ut+pal te yum lnga'i phyag mtshan bris pa'i tsa ka li slob ma'i spyi bo la sogs pa'i gnas lngar bzhag cing / oṃ bud+dha dha ra la sogs lnga brjod cing / mthar lag pa g.yon du sbyin pas/ dran pa dang shes rab ldan par gyis shig ces gsungs te dbang bskur ba'i mos pa mdzod/ de ni gsung gi dam tshig yin/ de nas rigs lnga'i phyag mtshan bris pa'i tsa ka li slob ma'i spyi bo la sogs pa'i gnas lngar gtugs te/ mthar lag pa g.yas su byin te/ oṃ bud+dha gu h+ya sogs lnga brjod/ de ltar na thabs ye shes lnga'i rtogs pa skyes par gyis shig ces gsungs te thugs kyi dam tshig gi don to/ /rdo rje dang dril bu thugs khar bsnol te/ oṃ prañdzā u pa sogs brjod/ de ltar khyed la rdo rje dril bu byin te dbang bskur bas khyed rdo rje slob dpon du gyur pa yin pas thabs shes rab stong pa dang / snying rje chen po dang mi 'bral ba'i sgo nas sems can gyi don gyis shig de nas/ de ring phyin chad bu khyod kyis/ /sogs sh+lau ka gcig dang / oṃ tsakra rat+na a bhi ṣiñtsa maṃ/ sogs rin chen sna bdun gyi tsa ka li rim pa bzhin sbyin tshar ba dang /

de ltar sbyin pa'i gnas skabs su 'khor los bsgyur ba'i rgyal srid dang / mthar thug kun rig rnam par snang mdzad kyi go 'phang thob par 'gyur ba yin no/ /de ltar mtha' brten rnams grub nas bka' bsgo ba 'di la gsan pas khyab par gda'/ tshe 'di'i bde ba ma lus dang / /sogs brjod/ de'i don ni 'di yin te/ dbang thob nas dam tshig la bsrung sdom tshul bzhin du byas na sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang myur du 'grub par 'gyur bas bla ma mnyes par bya dgos/ bla ma ma mnyes na sdug bsngal thams cad thob par 'gyur bas/ bla ma mnyes pa'i sgo nas rdo rje spun sogs rang gi grogs su shes par byas nas/ tshe 'di phyi'i bde skyid tsam la ma ltos/ dngos grub thams cad thob pas/ brnyas pa dang 'khon 'dzin mi byed par phan sems dang ldan pa'i sgo nas dam tshig rnams la nan tan du bya dgos so/ /de rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das kun rig rnam par snang mdzad kyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba zab mo thob pa yin pas/ de dag gi gnas skabs su khas blangs pa'i dam tshig dang sdom pa rnams la bsrung sdom tshul bzhin du bgyi snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum gyi bar du mdzod/ gtso bos ji ltar sogs dang / de nas dbang yongs su rdzogs pa'i gtang rag tu maṇ+ḍal 'bul ba zhu/ zhes maṇ+ḍal bdun ma rgyas pa phul la/ ma tshang ba med pa 'di nyid ni bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo tha dad med pa la dbang bskur zab mo thob pa'i gtang rag tu dbul bar bgyi'o/ /sogs brjod/ de ltar maṇ+ḍal phul nas lus longs spyod thams cad bla ma la phul nas/ cha shas kyis longs spyad du gsol snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum du brjod/ deng nas brtsams te sogs brjod/ de rnams kyis kun rig rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba thob pas rang gzhan gyi don rgya chen po mdzod/ bsod nams 'di yis sogs brjod la slob ma rnams rang gnas su btang ba ni tshe ldan dbang gis rjes su bzung ba'o/

/zhes pa 'di shrī sa skya pa shākya'i dge slong byams pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos snyigs dus kyi bstan pa'i nyi ma sngags 'chang chos kyi rgyal po kun dga' rin chen gyi gsung rab 'di dag ches cher 'phel zhing rgyas pa zhig byung na ci ma rung snyam pa'i lhag bsam rnam par dag pas kun nas bslangs te/ sngags 'chang de nyid kyis mdzad pa'i kun rig gi chog bsgrigs chen mo las/ dbang chog 'di nyid logs su bkod pa yin no/ /sarba maṅga laṃ// //gcig zhus// // ༈ mkhan chen a pad rin po che'i dgongs bzhed ltar gu rus zhabs zhu bgyis pa'o// PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 12 a myes zhabs/ ngag dbang kun dga' rin chen gyi kun rig gi chog khrigs chen mo las logs su bkod pa'i dbang chog PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 13
